title: Head Of Operations
description:
Why this role exists

Right now every founder is trying to run their function AND keep the company organized. It is not working. Targets slip. Meetings happen without agendas. Decisions don't reach the people who need them. Departments build their own processes in isolation. This role exists to fix that — to put a real operating rhythm around the whole company. You will report to the CEO and have full authority to build processes, set cadence, and hold every department to its commitments. You are not here to do strategy. You are here to make strategy happen.

What you will own

Operating rhythm — across every department:

• Run the Monday business standup (30 min, all leads, action items captured).

• Run the Friday close-out (what shipped, what slipped, what's at risk).

• Run a monthly business review with the founders — pre-read pack, agenda, decisions captured, follow-ups assigned.

• Own the action item log for every meeting that matters. Chase owners. No action item dies because nobody followed up.

KPIs and dashboards:

• Co-create with the CEO a single operating dashboard covering: sales pipeline, install velocity, recurring revenue, cash position, hiring, partner health.

• Define each KPI with a clear owner, target, and refresh cadence.

• Build in ClickUp + Google Sheets, or Notion + Looker Studio, or whichever stack is fastest to deploy.

• Maintain dashboard daily. Surface red flags to the CEO within 24 hours of a metric crossing a threshold.

Process design — across every department:

• Build operating playbooks for the repeating processes that today are reinvented each time: install onboarding for a new partner, partner quarterly business review, hiring loop, sales handoff to engineering, RMA handling.

• Document each process in plain language. Make it findable, followable, and updatable.

• Roll process out one department at a time.

• Audit adherence. If a process isn't being followed, find out why and either fix the process or escalate to the CEO.

Project management:

• Translate every CEO directive into a project plan with owner, deadline, dependencies, and milestone checkpoints.

• Hold the named owner accountable. Escalate if they miss commits twice in a row.

• Maintain the master project list. The CEO must be able to see at a glance what's in flight, what's at risk, what's overdue.

OKR ownership:

• Build the quarterly OKR cycle. Each function sets OKRs aligned to company goals.

• Run quarterly OKR review with the founders. Score, learn, reset

nts, adding captions, and following established editing workflows.



This role requires both technical editing ability and editorial judgment. You should be comfortable making decisions about pacing, trimming content, removing mistakes, tightening responses, and helping create engaging short-form videos from raw footage.



For example:



A doctor may answer a question in 60 seconds, but the strongest version of that answer may only be 25 seconds.



A speaker may stumble over a sentence, repeat themselves, use filler words, or correct themselves midway through a thought.



Your job is to clean up those responses and create the strongest, most natural version possible while preserving the speaker's intended meaning.



Responsibilities



* Organize raw footage and project files

* Break interviews into individual clips and sequences

* Identify strong 
nts and potential hooks

* Create rough-cut timelines for short-form content

* Remove filler words, mistakes, dead air, and unnecessary content

* Tighten responses to improve pacing and retention

* Add animated captions using AutoCut

* Follow documented editing systems and workflows



Required Skills



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Experience editing short-form content

* Understanding of social media pacing and retention

* Strong organizational skills

* Ability to follow tutorials and documented workflows

* Good written English communication



AutoCut experience is preferred but not required. You should be willing to learn it quickly if selected.

title: Inbound Sales & Client Services Coordinator (Remote | Performance-Based)
description:
WHO WE ARE

 

Clock Clean Services (CCS) is a commercial cleaning company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. We serve general contractors, property managers, and national accounts across the United States — post-construction cleans, move-in/move-out, and commercial maintenance.

 

We don't operate like most cleaning companies. We run lean, we hold high standards, and we build systems that scale. Every person on our team is here because they produce results — not because they clock hours.

 

Our standard is simple: We Finish It. If you bring that same energy to your work every day, you'll thrive here.

 

THE ROLE

 

We are looking for a Client Services Coordinator who owns the client-facing side of our business. This is not a customer support role. This is a revenue-generating, relationship-building, deal-closing position.

 

You will be the first voice clients hear. You'll answer inbound inquiries, qualify leads, issue quotes, follow up, and close booked business. You'll also manage ongoing client relationships and make sure every client feels taken care of — before, during, and after their job.

 

This role is fully remote and fully performance-based. There is no base hourly rate. Your earnings are tied directly to your output — deals closed, clients retained, and scorecard performance. High performers earn well. Low performers don't last.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Answer and manage all inbound client inquiries via phone and

• Issue accurate quotes and actively close booked business

• Follow up on open leads until resolved — no lead left unattended

• Maintain a 60% minimum close rate on inbound opportunities (70%+ target)

• Build and maintain client relationships — retention and repeat business is part of your scorecard

• Log all lead, quote, and deal activity in our CRM within 24 hours

• Coordinate with our operations team to ensure seamless job delivery

• Represent Clock Clean Services with professionalism, warmth, and confidence on every call

 

COMPENSATION STRUCTURE

 

This role is 100% performance-based. No hourly floor. Your pay is driven by what you produce:

 

Commission:  Earn on the gross margin of every deal you close — 10% on small deals, 7.5% on mid-size, 5% on large deals

 

Scorecard Bonus:  Hit your monthly performance targets and earn a cash bonus — up to $150/month

 

No-Refund Bonus:  $50/month in any month with zero client refunds on your jobs

 

Commission is paid within 7 days of confirmed fund collection. Bonuses paid within 7 days of month-end review.

 

If you're the kind of person who performs at a high level consistently, this structure pays you significantly more than a flat hourly rate ever would.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

Skills and experience matter — but character matters more. We are looking for someone who:

 

? Communicates in clear, professional English — spoken and written

? Has experience in sales, client services, or customer-facing roles

? Is comfortable closing deals on the phone without a script crutch

? Responds fast — our standard is within 1 hour during working hours

? Is detail-oriented and never lets things fall through the cracks

? Takes ownership — if something goes wrong on your watch, you fix it

? Is self-motivated and doesn't need to be managed to produce

? Believes that how you do anything is how you do everything

 

THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF...

 

• You need a guaranteed hourly rate to feel secure

• You're looking for a low-pressure, low-accountability role

• You disappear when things get busy or difficult

• You treat client interactions as tasks to complete rather than relationships to build

• You need to be reminded to follow up

 

HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, complete all steps below.



1. VIDEO INTRODUCTION (2–4 Minutes)



Record a Loom video answering:



• Tell us about yourself and your work experience.

• Describe a time you turned an unhappy customer into a satisfied one.

• How do you build trust with someone on a phone call?



?



2. CLIENT SERVICE EXERCISE



A customer calls and immediately asks:



“How much do you charge?”



Answer:



• What would you say first?

• What questions would you ask?

• How would you move the conversation toward booking?



?



3. DECISION QUESTIONS



Answer clearly:



1. What do you do if a customer needs an answer but you don’t know it?

2. How do you handle multiple clients needing help at the same time?

3. What is more important: answering quickly or answering accurately? Why?



?



4. ORGANIZATION EXERCISE



A Monday morning starts with:



• 5 new leads

• 3 customers needing updates

• 2 jobs needing scheduling confirmation



Explain:



• What do you handle first?

• What order do you prioritize tasks?

• How do you make sure nothing gets missed?



?



5. SUBJECT LINE



Client Services Coordinator – [Your Name]



?



FINAL NOTE



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys:



• Talking with people

• Building client relationships

• Solving problems

• Staying organized

• Turning inquiries into booked business



You will be trusted with real responsibility and expected to think independently.



We are building systems, growing quickly, and looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term.

We use Trello, JotForm, Claude, MS365 and Xero (accounting software). You do not need Xero experience, but you have to understand the basics of accounting book-keeping. 



10 hours per week minimum. We offered 4 weeks paid leave (2 of which must be at Christmas). There is a possibility of additional work from time to time.

title: Executive Operations Coordinator / Project Follow-Through Manager
description:
Executive Operations Coordinator / Project Follow-Through Manager



Job Description



I am looking for a highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented person to support a busy executive who manages many different projects, people, ideas, and moving parts.



This role is for someone who is excellent at turning scattered information into clear lists, next steps, reminders, follow-ups, and progress reports.



The executive you will support is a visionary, fast-moving, idea-driven person who works across multiple areas at once. He needs someone steady, organized, persistent, and practical to help keep projects moving from idea to completion.



This is not a basic admin role. It is also not a sales role. The main goal is to create structure, follow through, organize communication, and make sure important things do not fall through the cracks.



Main Responsibilities



- Organize many open projects into clear trackers, lists, and next actions

- Follow up with people by
, text, phone, or messaging apps

- Keep track of who was contacted, what they said, and what the next step is

- Prepare simple daily and weekly progress reports

- Help the executive stay focused on current priorities

- Remind the executive of pending decisions respectfully

- Turn voice notes, texts, rough ideas, and messy notes into organized action lists

- Create and maintain Google Sheets, Google Docs, checklists, and project trackers

- Coordinate with vendors, contacts, service providers, tea
mbers, and outside parties

- Notice when something is stuck and bring it back to attention

- Ask clear questions when instructions are incomplete

- Help create simple systems so repeated tasks become easier over time



The Type of Person I Am Looking For



You should be calm, organized, reliable, persistent, practical, emotionally steady, comfortable with follow-up, and good at bringing order to messy information.



You should naturally think:



- What is the next action?

- Who owns this?

- What is stuck?

- What needs follow-up?

- What decision is needed?



This Role Is Not for Someone Who



- Waits silently when confused

- Needs every instruction to be perfect

- Disappears when things are unclear

- Is afraid to follow up with people

- Only wants simple repetitive tasks

- Gets overwhelmed by multiple projects

- Says yes but does not complete things

- Needs constant motivation

- Is too passive



Daily Report



At the end of each workday, send a short report:



1. What moved today

2. What is stuck

3. Who needs follow-up

4. What decision is needed from the executive

5. Top priorities for tomorrow



Required Skills



- Excellent written English

- Strong organization skills

- Google Sheets and Google Docs

-
 and message follow-up

- Basic project management

- Clear communication

- Ability to work independently

- Ability to summarize messy information clearly



Helpful but Not Required



- Notion, Trello, Todoist, ClickUp, Obsidian, AI tools, Google Workspace, Salesforce, or project management tools

- Experience supporting founders, executives, entrepreneurs, or project managers



Work Schedule



Full-time remote position.

Must be available for regular communication and partial overlap with U.S. hours.



Pay



Starting pay depends on experience.

Please include your expected monthly salary in PHP.

Strong candidates who can truly manage follow-through and operations will be considered at a higher rate.



Application Questions



1. Tell me about a role where you helped a busy person stay organized and get things done.

2. How do you track many open tasks at the same time?

3. What would you do if the executive gives you unclear or incomplete instructions?

4. How do you follow up with someone who does not respond?

5. Are you comfortable reminding your boss about things that are overdue?

6. What tools have you used for project tracking or operations?

7. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?

8. Are you available full-time?

9. What hours can you work in Philippine time?

WHO WE ARE

 

Clock Clean Services (CCS) is a commercial cleaning company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. We serve general contractors, property managers, and national accounts across the United States.

 

We run a tight, high-standard operation. Our systems are clean, our expectations are clear, and we hold everyone on our team — including ourselves — to the same standard: accurate, on time, every time.

 

We don't hire people to fill seats. We hire people who take ownership of their lane and execute with precision.

 

THE ROLE

 

We are looking for a Bookkeeper to own the financial record-keeping side of Clock Clean Services. This is a focused, well-defined role — no ambiguity, no scope creep. You process what comes in, reconcile what needs reconciling, and keep our books clean.

 

This role is per-task based — you are paid for what you complete accurately. There is no hourly retainer. If you work fast and accurately, you earn well. If your work requires correction, it comes back to you before payment clears.

 

This starts as a part-time engagement and has a clear path to full-time as the business scales.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 

• Process all Company invoices — log, code, and file accurately

• Perform account reconciliations for all designated Company accounts

• Process expense reports as submitted by Company leadership

• Execute and submit payroll runs on schedule — never late

• Maintain organized, accurate financial records in our accounting system

• Flag any discrepancies or anomalies to leadership the same day identified

• Provide monthly financial summaries as requested

 

COMPENSATION STRUCTURE

 

Pay is per task, per completion. Here is the rate schedule:

 

Task - Rate - Notes

Invoice Processing - $1.50 per invoice - Per invoice logged, coded, and filed accurately

Account Reconciliation - $8.00 per account - Per account reconciled and confirmed

REQUIREMENTS

title: Heir Outreach Specialist
description:
We are hiring a confident, persuasive, and highly proactive Heir Outreach Specialist to help our real estate investment company contact property owners and heirs connected to distressed Florida properties. This is not a passive admin role. This role is for someone who enjoys starting conversations, moving people to action, asking direct questions, and staying calm when a family situation is complicated.



Our business solves title problems involving inherited property, probate issues, tax deed risk, liens, judgments, and family ownership problems. Your job is to help us reach the right heirs, confirm family relationships, gather key facts, build trust quickly, and keep communication moving so our acquisitions and transaction teams can close deals.



What You Will Do

• Call, text, and follow up with heirs and property owners connected to inherited or distressed Florida real estate.

• Start conversations confidently with people who may not be expecting your call.

• Identify decision-makers inside families with multiple heirs, siblings, children, spouses, or extended relatives.

• Ask clear fact-finding questions about family relationships, deceased owners, probate status, property history, occupancy, and seller motivation.

• Build rapport quickly while still keeping the conversation focused and productive.

• Overcome hesitation and confusion without being pushy, rude, or robotic.

• Document every conversation accurately inside our CRM so the rest of the team knows exactly what happened and what needs to happen next.

• Coordinate warm handoffs to the acquisitions team when a seller or heir is ready to discuss an offer.

• Persistently follow up until the family situation is understood, the right person is reached, or the lead is properly disqualified.



Who This Role Is Perfect For

• You are naturally confident on the phone and do not freeze when someone is guarded, confused, emotional, or skeptical.

• You like winning conversations, solving people puzzles, and figuring out who has authority inside a family.

• You are comfortable being direct, but you know how to sound respectful and human.

• You move fast, follow up aggressively, and do not need to be reminded five times to complete the next step.

• You prefer clear goals, measurable results, and real responsibility over repetitive low-impact admin work.

• You can handle messy information, incomplete family trees, and leads where the first person you reach is not the final decision-maker.

• You are energized by the challenge of turning cold or lukewarm contacts into productive conversations.



You Will Not Be a Fit If

• You are uncomfortable making outbound calls or speaking with strangers.

• You need every step scripted before you can take action.

• You avoid difficult conversations or give up after one unanswered call.

• You are careless with notes, names, dates, phone numbers, or relationship details.

• You sound overly timid, overly formal, or robotic on the phone.

• You prefer back-office data entry and do not want to be accountable for outreach results.



Required Skills

• Strong spoken English with a clear, confident, professional phone presence.

• Experience with outbound calling, sales, appointment setting, customer service, collections, real estate, legal intake, probate, or lead follow-up is strongly preferred.

• Ability to ask questions, listen carefully, and control the direction of a conversation.

• Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, and phone software.

• Fast and accurate note-taking after calls and text conversations.

• Stable internet connection, quiet work environment, and reliable computer.

• High ownership: you follow through without needing constant supervision.



Real Estate / Probate Experience

You do not need to be an expert in Florida probate or curative title work before starting. We will train the right person on our lead types, terminology, workflows, and CRM process. However, you must be a fast learner, comfortable with complex family situations, and willing to study the business so you can improve quickly.

title: Executive Operations Assistant
description:
About the Business

We are a Florida-focused curative title real estate investing company. We work on properties with complicated ownership, probate, heirship, tax, lien, and title issues. Our business depends on clean follow-through, accurate documents, organized files, consistent communication, and disciplined execution from signed purchase agreement through attorney handoff, probate progress, document completion, and closing readiness.



Role Overview

This is not a generic virtual assistant role. We are looking for a calm, steady, detail-driven Executive Operations Assistant who can become the operational control point for the COO. The right person will keep the COO organized, coordinate transaction and notary workflows, monitor probate case progress, maintain complete deal files, and audit documents before key handoffs.



You should enjoy structure, checklists, clean folders, accurate notes, careful follow-up, and quiet execution. You do not need to be loud, salesy, or highly social. You do need to be reliable, precise, patient, consistent, and comfortable holding people accountable to next steps.



Core Responsibilities

1. Executive Assistant to the COO

• Protect the COO’s time by organizing priorities, reminders, follow-ups, meetings, and action items.

• Prepare daily priority lists, meeting notes, agendas, and post-meeting task summaries.

• Monitor assigned inboxes, messages, calendars, documents, and task lists for urgent items and missed follow-ups.

• Turn verbal instructions into clear written tasks, checklists, and next actions.

• Maintain calm, professional communication while supporting a fast-moving operator.



2. Transaction / Notary / Closing Coordination

• Coordinate mobile notary appointments with sellers, heirs, and notaries after purchase agreements are signed.

• Prepare and organize signing packages, notary instructions, FedEx labels, tracking links, and scanback requirements.

• Track execution of Joinders, Quitclaim Deeds, Assignments of Interest, Affidavits of Heirs, copies of IDs, and related documents.

• Review scanbacks for completeness before forwarding packages to the proper internal tea
mber, probate attorney, or closing-related party.

• Maintain transaction status, next steps, blockers, and deadlines in the CRM/project management system.



3. Probate Case Coordination

• Monitor probate-related deal progress and maintain case status updates.

• Communicate with probate attorneys and internal tea
mbers to track what is pending, filed, missing, signed, recorded, or ready for next action.

• Maintain open-items lists for each probate file, including missing heirs, missing documents, pending attorney tasks, and court/status updates.

• Organize probate documents, attorney correspondence, family/heir notes, and supporting evidence in the correct folders.

• Escalate stalled cases before they become forgotten cases.



4. Deal File Management / Curative File Control

• Keep every deal file clean, complete, and easy to understand.

• Maintain digital folders, naming conventions, document checklists, title issue notes, heir charts, seller information, and transaction records.

• Ensure each file has a clear current status, next action, responsible person, and due date.

• Prepare clean handoff packages for attorneys, title companies, internal reviewers, or closing coordination.

• Prevent scattered information, duplicate documents, missing IDs, incorrect versions, and unclear file history.



5. Quality Control / Document Audit

• Audit documents before signing, after scanback, before attorney handoff, and before title/closing handoff.

• Check names, dates, signatures, notarizations, legal descriptions, attachments, IDs, missing pages, and consistency across documents.

• Flag issues clearly and early instead of assuming someone else will catch them.

• Maintain QC checklists and document audit logs.

• Help the team reduce costly errors, closing delays, and repeated requests to sellers or heirs.



The Person Who Will Thrive in This Role

• You are calm under pressure and do not need constant excitement to stay engaged.

• You naturally create order out of scattered information.

• You are comfortable with repetitive follow-up, checklists, and status tracking.

• You notice small details that other people miss.

• You are professional, direct, and respectful when following up with sellers, notaries, attorneys, and internal tea
mbers.

• You can manage up: if the COO misses a decision, deadline, or open item, you will respectfully bring it back to the front.

• You prefer accuracy over speed, but you can still move quickly when the process is clear.

• You are loyal, stable, consistent, and serious about long-term work.



This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If...

• You need a highly social, chatty, people-heavy role to feel energized.

• You dislike repetitive checklists, document review, file organization, or administrative follow-through.

• You prefer improvising over following a proven process.

• You get bored when the work requires precision, patience, and consistency.

• You avoid following up because you do not want to bother people.

• You are uncomfortable working behind the scenes in a support and coordination role.

• You want a sales, negotiation, or lead-generation role instead of an operations support role.



Required Skills and Experience

• Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

• Strong organization, task tracking, and file management ability.

• High attention to detail when reviewing names, documents, dates, IDs, signatures, and instructions.

• Comfortable using CRMs, Google Drive, Google Sheets,
, calendars, messaging tools, and project/task systems.

• Ability to work Central Time Zone hours consistently.

• Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment.

• Experience as an Executive Assistant, Transaction Coordinator, Legal Assistant, Real Estate VA, Probate Assistant, Title Assistant, or Operations Coordinator is preferred.

• Experience with U.S. real estate, probate, legal documents, notary coordination, or title-related work is a strong advantage, but trainability and accuracy matter most.



Tools You May Use

• Pipedrive or similar CRM

• Google Workspace: Gmail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar

• Phone/messaging systems such as Quo, WhatsApp, or similar

• Project/task management tools

• FedEx label and tracking workflows

• Shared digital folders and document checklists



Success Metrics

• No unsigned, missing, or incomplete document packages sent forward without being flagged.

• Every active transaction has a current status, next step, owner, and due date.

• Notary appointments, FedEx labels, scanbacks, attorney handoffs, and follow-ups are tracked without gaps.

• Probate cases do not stall silently; blockers are identified and escalated.

• Deal files are clean, organized, and ready for review at any time.

• The COO has fewer dropped balls, fewer reminders to give, and more operational visibility.



First 30/60/90 Days - Timeframe & Expected Progress



First 30 Days

Learn the business model, tools, document types, folder structure, transaction workflow, and daily communication rhythm. Begin supporting COO priorities and tracking simple tasks.



First 60 Days

Own notary coordination, scanback tracking, deal file organization, and basic QC checklists with supervision. Begin maintaining probate status trackers and open-items lists.



First 90 Days

Operate as the daily control point for COO support, transaction coordination, probate tracking, file hygiene, and document audit workflows. Identify process gaps and help improve SOPs.



Schedule and Compensation

• $5/hour starting compensation plus deal bonuses.

• Central Time Zone working hours required.

• Long-term opportunity for someone who becomes dependable, accurate, and deeply trusted.

• Deal bonuses are tied to successful transaction progress and closed deals, based on internal company policy.



How to Apply

To apply, reply with the subject line: "Executive Operations Assistant - Detail Control" and include the following:

1. A short paragraph explaining why you are a strong fit for a detail-heavy operations support role.

2. Your experience with executive assistance, transaction coordination, real estate, legal documents, probate, title, notary coordination, or file management.

3. A specific example of a time you caught a small detail that prevented a bigger problem.

4. A specific example of how you track multiple open tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups.

5. Your availability in Central Time Zone hours.

6. Your internet speed, computer setup, and whether you have a quiet work environment.

7. Confirm that you are comfortable with $5/hour plus deal bonuses.

8.     Provide DISC test results: 
/disc-personality-test/

9.     Copy of resume.



Small Detail Test

At the end of your application, write this exact sentence:

"I understand that this role requires calm consistency, accurate follow-up, and clean files."



Applications that do not follow the instructions above may not be reviewed. This role is for someone who pays close attention to details before the job even begins.

title: Video Editor for Faceless Youtube Channels (Archival & B-Roll Master)
description:
My name is Niko, and we are scaling a network of high-growth YouTube channels that focus on historical, cultural, and educational storytelling



example(not our channel): 



We are not looking for a standard "faceless channel" editor who just throws stock clips over a voiceover. We are looking for a Visual Historian/Storyteller who can take a deep-dive script and turn it into a cinematic experience.



The "Simple" Paradox: While the technical execution may seem simple, the taste required is immense. You must know how to use 1960s archival photos, subtle textures, and intentional pacing to keep a viewer captivated for 40 minutes.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:



* Narrative Sourcing: Finding the perfect historical image or clip—not just the first "barbecue" result on Pexels, but an authentic 1960s South archival photo that matches the soul of the script.



* Pacing & Retention: Mastering the "slow-burn" edit. You know when to let a photo breathe and when to use subtle motion (Ken Burns effect) to maintain focus.



* Soundscapes: Crafting immersive audio. You’ll use foley, ambient background noise, and era-appropriate music to ground the viewer in the story.



* Thumbnails: Creating high-quality, "clickable" art that looks like a documentary poster (experience in this style is mandatory).



Position Details & Expected Output:

* Schedule: Monday to Saturday (Flexible hours).

* Output: 1 high-quality video ever 2 days. Note: While the style is "clean," we expect a high level of intentionality in every frame.

* Salary: $400 USD per month + performance-based bonuses (e.g., $150 bonuses for 100k+ views milestones).

* Growth: This is a long-term play with scaling pay as the network grows.



Requirements (Crucial):

* Documentary Sensibilities: You understand how to edit for a mature, curious audience.

* Visual Taste: You can distinguish between "cheap stock footage" and "cinematic b-roll/archival assets."

* Independent Creator Mindset: You can spot a boring section of a 40-minute script and save it with a clever visual hook or a shift in sound design without being micromanaged.

* Reliability: You can maintain a "4 videos per week" rhythm without sacrificing the aesthetic quality.



Ideal Candidate:

* You have an eye for historical accuracy and "vibe" consistency.

* You are a master of the "Ken Burns" effect, film grain overlays, and clean, elegant typography.



How to Apply:

1. Start your application with your favorite animal.

2. Portfolio: Provide 2–3 examples of work that show storytelling. If your portfolio is just fast-paced "gaming" edits or "bright/loud" automation videos, please do not apply. We want to see "Video Essay" or "Documentary" styles.

3. Context: Briefly explain your experience with long-form retention (20+ minute videos).

4. Logistics: Confirm your availability for a 6-day-a-week workflow.

title: GHL EXPERT
description:
**Job Title:** GoHighLevel Specialist (Part-Time, Ongoing, $400-$500/mo, Start ASAP)



**Job Description:**



Health and wellness practice needs a GoHighLevel specialist to build and maintain funnels, a full website, landing pages, and
 automations. This is ongoing work, not a one-time project.



Hours: 10 -12 hours/week with option to increase.



First projects: Build sales pages, thank you pages, and order pages for two funnels (a digital course and a lab test funnel). Set up full
 sequences with conditional automations for both. Later, build a complete website inside GHL.



Ongoing: New funnels, page updates,
 edits, workflow troubleshooting, and website maintenance. Future projects will likely include setting up and managing a community forum inside GHL, lead tracking, and text automations. 



We have templates for all of the pages, and content will be provided.



YOU MUST HAVE:



1. 12+ months building funnels and websites for clients inside GoHighLevel (not WordPress, ClickFunnels, Kajabi, or Kartra).

2. Hands-on experience with GHL workflows: triggers, wait steps, if/else branches, tags, and pipelines.

3. Experience building full websites (not just single landing pages) inside GHL.

4. Portfolio of GHL pages and/or websites you built (live links or screenshots).

5. Ability to start within 5 business days.



Bonus: Experience with GHL's community/membership features is a strong plus.



TO APPLY: ANSWER THESE 3 QUESTIONS

(Applications that skip any question will not be reviewed.)



1. Show your work. Send 2 to 3 live links or screenshots of GHL funnel pages or websites you built. For bonus points, include a short Loom video walking me through one build.



2. Show a workflow. Attach a screenshot from inside GHL's workflow builder showing a real automation you created. Tell me in 2 sentences what it does.



3. Solve this scenario. A customer purchases a course. They get a welcome
 immediately, then login instructions 24 hours later. If they have not logged in after 72 hours, they get a reminder. If they have logged in, no reminder is sent. Walk me through exactly how you build this in GHL: which triggers, which workflow steps, which conditions.



NOTE: If your experience is mainly on other platforms and you plan to learn GHL on this job, this is not the right fit. I am looking for someone who already works in GoHighLevel daily.

title: Static Meta Ads Designer for Mobile Wellness App
description:
We are looking for a talented static ad designer to create high-quality paid social ads for Azora, a mobile wellness app that helps users calm down through guided breathing and phone-camera heart rate measurement.



This role is focused on static ads only. We are looking for image-based ad creatives for Meta/Facebook/Instagram, including feed ads, story ads, app screenshot ads, UGC-style statics, and direct-response app install ads.



We want someone who can design static ads in the style of apps like Calm, Headspace, Breathwrk, BetterSleep, and other modern wellness apps.



This role is not just about making pretty graphics. We need someone who can think like a creative strategist. You should be able to come up with strong ad angles, understand why an ad might convert, and turn simple ideas into clear, scroll-stopping static ads.



Azora helps users:

- Reduce stress

- Follow guided breathing exercises

- Measure heart rate using only their phone camera

- See their body calming down in real time



Responsibilities:

- Design static ad creatives for Meta/Facebook/Instagram

- Create multiple ad concepts and variations from one idea

- Think of new ad angles, hooks, and creative formats

- Use app screenshots and product visuals in a clean, premium way

- Study reference ads from Calm, Headspace, Breathwrk, and other wellness apps

- Understand what makes an ad clear, emotional, and clickable

- Follow briefs closely while also bringing your own creative ideas

- Deliver editable source files and exported PNG/JPG files

- Create ads in common formats such as 1080x1080 and 1080x1920

- Iterate quickly based on feedback and performance data



Requirements:

- Experience designing static ads for paid social

- Strong portfolio with real ad creative examples

- Good creative thinking, not just design execution

- Ability to come up with hooks, angles, and layouts

- Understanding of Meta/Facebook/Instagram ad formats

- Strong sense of direct-response design

- Ability to make ads that are simple, readable, and conversion-focused

- Experience with Canva, Figma, Photoshop, or similar tools

- Good eye for mobile app, wellness, health, or lifestyle design

- Comfortable making many variations of the same concept

- Reliable communication and fast turnaround time



Nice to have:

- Experience with wellness, meditation, fitness, sleep, health, or mobile app ads

- Experience designing ads similar to Calm, Headspace, Breathwrk, BetterSleep, or other app brands

- Experience with app install campaigns

- Basic understanding of creative testing for paid ads

- Ability to research competitors and suggest new ad ideas



To apply, please send:

1. The word “AZORA” at the top of your application

2. Your portfolio

3. 3–5 examples of static ads you designed

4. Any examples that are similar to Calm, Headspace, wellness, fitness, sleep, or mobile app ads

5. Your experience with Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads

6. Your usual turnaround time for 5 static ad variations

7. 3 ad angles you would test for Azora and why you think they could work



This will start with a paid test project. If the work is strong, this can become an ongoing long-term role.



Applications without a portfolio and real ad examples will not be considered.

title: Financial Analysis/Proforma/Scenario Planning for a US-based Healthcare Business
description:
We are looking for someone to help build a robust financial proforma model for our healthcare business with a focus on profitability.

This model needs to be flexible enough to offer insight into the profitability of each of (currently 20) clinicians where each has a slightly different compensation structure. That needs to include a breakeven analysis and the ability to change parameters such as hourly pay rate, weekly number of recorded sessions, Payer average reimbursement, employers health insurance and 401k contributions, estimated tax set aside, PTO pay modeling, etc, so we can see the effect on profitability of such changes

The model needs to roll up to a dashboard that is simple enough for clinical leadership to model various scenarios to see the impact of proposed pay structures

We have developed a model that could be used as a starting point if helpful

title: Sales Manager
description:
Pex Life Records LLC: Our Vision for Transformative Music



Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.



You will be joining a brand with a strong, engaged audience of over 1,000
 subscribers and 20,
 followers. Your work will directly contribute to inspiring and uplifting thousands through music.-----The Role: Drive Revenue, Build a Team, Shape a Brand



We are seeking a highly motivated Music Manager to lead our sales, operations, and team development. This is a pivotal role for a professional ready to commit to a 45-50 hour/week position that offers substantial commission potential and a clear path to high earnings.



Key Areas of Impact:

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

Team Leadership: Recruit, hire, train, and inspire contractors and staff to ensure stellar performance and successful new releases.

Operations & Finance: Manage contracts, maintain essential financial records (bookkeeping), and ensure compliance and seamless communication across all stakeholders.

Customer Experience: Be the face of the company, creating memorable customer experiences, explaining product/service prices, and handling key inquiries.



Compensation & Uncapped Earning Potential



This is a performance-driven role with a clear path to significant monthly income through our incentive program.

Base & Growth: The hourly rate starts at $2.81 USD plus commission. The initial 10 hours/week commitment quickly scales up to 45 hours/week within 45 days, allowing for a rapid increase in base earnings.

Monthly Compensation Range: $505–$900 Guaranteed Base + Generous Commission.



Compensation Structure by Target Revenue Goal:

Achieve $1,200 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $675 Minimum. Commission Rate: 10% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: 13th Month Pay, Internet Costs Reimbursement, Profit Sharing, PhilHealth Reimbursement.

Achieve $2,400 Minimum: Guaranteed Monthly Base: $900 Minimum. Commission Rate: 15% on qualifying sales. Enhanced Benefits Package: Social Security System & Pag-IBIG Fund Reimbursement, 50% HMO Expenses, Profit Sharing.



Flexibility and Structure:



100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!



Application Instructions:



Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

You are encouraged to ask questions when something is unclear. I prefer someone who asks before guessing, especially when dealing with customers, suppliers, pricing, shipping, returns, warranties, or order issues.



As the business grows and you prove you are reliable, responsibilities can increase and pay can also increase based on performance.



Main tasks may include:



Responding to customer
s, SMS, and calls in English, including order updates, product questions, quote follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and general customer support.

Helping with Shopify product uploads and product updates.



Creating, editing, and improving Shopify product listings using supplier information.



Reviewing product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, warranty details, shipping details, and product page accuracy.



Helping identify missing product information, incorrect specs, weak descriptions, pricing issues, or product pages that need improvement.



Reviewing product pages for missing or incorrect information.



Keeping CRM sheets and internal spreadsheets organized.



Updating customer notes, supplier notes, order notes, lead status, and follow-up status.



Helping with warranty, return, cancellation, delivery, and supplier communication.

s, screenshots, order details, tracking information, supplier communication, customer communication, and timelines. Final decisions on refunds, disputes, cancellations, compensation, or discounts are handled by management.



Handling customer problems professionally and knowing when to escalate an issue before making promises or decisions.



Following SOPs and training videos for each task.



Suggesting improvements to processes, product pages, customer communication, follow-ups, spreadsheets, or SOPs after learning how the business works.



You will not be expected to know everything on day one. I will assign specific tasks and provide instructions, examples, and training videos when needed.



Requirements:



Please do not apply if you do not think you qualify.



Advanced written and spoken English for U.S. customer communication.



Confident speaking with U.S. customers by phone in clear, professional English.



Please only apply if you are comfortable handling conversations in English with U.S. customers, including questions, follow-ups, problems, delays, delivery concerns, warranty issues, and customer complaints.



Spoken English will be verified through a short Zoom, Google Meet, or similar video call during the hiring process.



Comfortable answering calls, making follow-up calls, replying to SMS, and handling customer issues professionally.



Able to communicate clearly when there is a problem, delay, warranty issue, delivery concern, or customer complaint.



Experience with Shopify, e-commerce operations, customer support, product listings, SEO edits, pricing checks, or virtual assistant work.



Experience with high-ticket e-commerce stores, supplier-direct shipping, freight products, warranty cases, returns, or multi-brand online stores is strongly preferred.



Experience using Google Sheets, CRM sheets, spreadsheets, or similar tools to stay organized.



Able to work with the U.S. market and U.S. customers.



Available full-time during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, for customer calls, SMS,
s, supplier follow-ups, Shopify tasks, and order updates.



Must have reliable internet.



Must be able to use a VPN when needed.



Strong attention to detail.



Organized and able to keep accurate notes.



Able to follow step-by-step instructions carefully.



Comfortable checking supplier websites, product pages, pricing, shipping details, and competitor pages.



Able to ask questions when something is unclear instead of guessing.



Able to work with urgency when a task is assigned.



Able to suggest useful ideas, improvements, or better ways to organize work after understanding the business process.



Must understand that refunds, cancellations, discounts, returns, disputes, or compensation cannot be approved without owner approval.



Experience using Slack or similar communication tools is a plus, but not required.



Important:



This business sells high-ticket products, so mistakes can be expensive. A wrong product detail, wrong price, missed follow-up, or incorrect promise to a customer can create serious problems.



You should not promise customers exact delivery dates unless they are confirmed. You should not approve refunds, returns, cancellations, discounts, disputes, or compensation unless I specifically authorize it.



You must be careful when checking prices because different brands have different margins, supplier costs, shipping fees, MAP rules, and competitor pricing.



This is not a simple task-based role where you only reply to messages. I am looking for someone who can help keep operations organized, follow processes, communicate professionally, and grow into more responsibility over time.



Examples of tasks you may receive:



“Check if this product is in stock with the supplier and confirm the shipping cost.”



“Reply to this customer asking for a delivery update.”



“Call this customer and confirm their shipping address.”



“Call or text this customer who started checkout but did not complete the order.”



“Follow up with this lead and ask if they have any questions before purchasing.”



“Compare our price with this competitor and calculate the margin.”



“Update the CRM sheet with the customer status and next follow-up.”



“Check this Shopify order/customer profile and update the CRM sheet with the latest status.”



“Check if this product page is missing warranty, shipping, or specification details.”



“Upload these products to Shopify using this supplier page.”



“Review this product listing and improve the title, description, specifications, SEO title, and meta description.”



“Organize this supplier information in the supplier database.”



“Follow up with this supplier about tracking or freight delivery.”



“Review this customer issue and prepare a draft response.”



“Organize documents and communication related to a warranty claim, return, delivery issue, dispute, or chargeback.”



How to apply:



Please message me here if you are interested.



To show that you read the full post carefully, start your message with:



“Hi Chris, I can help with U.S. e-commerce operations.”



Also, somewhere in your application, mention:



“CRM sheet”



If possible, please include a short video or voice recording speaking in English. This can be a Loom video, Google Drive link, or any similar link where I can hear you speak clearly.



This is not required, but it will strongly help your application and hiring decision. In the video, please briefly introduce yourself, explain your e-commerce/customer support experience, and mention if you have experience with high-ticket products, supplier-direct shipping, freight items, warranty cases, returns, or multi-brand online stores.



It would also be very helpful if you explain your experience with Shopify product listings, including product uploads, product titles, descriptions, specifications,  SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, pricing updates, or reviewing product pages for missing information.



You can also explain how you would handle customer issues such as delayed orders, delivery concerns, warranty problems, refund requests, or customers asking for exact delivery dates.



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer these questions in your own words. I want to understand your real experience, communication style, and judgment, so please do not use AI-generated responses.



1. Have you worked with Shopify, customer service, or e-commerce operations before? Explain briefly.



2. Have you worked with high-ticket e-commerce products, supplier-direct shipping, freight items, or multi-brand online stores before? If yes, please explain your experience.



3. Are you comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone in English?



4. Are you available full-time during U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, for assigned tasks, calls, SMS,
s, and follow-ups?



5. Have you used Google Sheets, CRM sheets, or spreadsheets to manage customer/order information?



6. Have you used Slack or similar communication tools before?



7. Have you helped create, edit, or improve Shopify product listings before? If yes, what parts have you handled? For example: product titles, descriptions, specifications, images, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, collections, or pricing.



8. If you have worked with other e-commerce stores before, what is one process, system, product page, or customer communication workflow you helped improve?



9. A customer asks for an exact delivery date, but the supplier only gave an estimated transit time. How would you respond?



10. Before telling a customer that a product is in stock, what would you check?



11. If a customer asks for a refund, discount, cancellation, return, dispute update, or compensation, what would you do before confirming anything?



12. Are you able to use a VPN to check U.S. competitor pricing and product availability?



13. Are you willing to do a short Zoom or Google Meet call so we can verify your spoken English and communication skills?



If you have any questions before applying, feel free to include them in your message. I will be reviewing applications and answering questions through the chat.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



Thanks!



Chris

title: QA, Release & Platform Engineer
description:
About The Product



We are building a B2B SaaS platform focused on marketing attribution, conversion tracking, revenue measurement and privacy-conscious data collection.



The platform helps businesses understand the difference between platform-reported performance and actual business outcomes by connecting advertising platforms, websites, CRM systems and revenue sources.



Because the platform operates in a privacy-sensitive environment and processes attribution, tracking and revenue data, accuracy, reliability and data integrity are critical.



Our customers rely on the platform to make marketing and business decisions. A bug, release issue or implementation mistake can impact reporting, attribution, revenue calculations, privacy-related functionality and customer trust.



We are looking for a technically strong engineer who can help ensure the platform remains stable, secure, maintainable and production-ready as it grows.



?



The Role



We are looking for a Part-Time QA, Release & Platform Engineer who will act as an independent technical reviewer and quality gate between development and production.



Your primary responsibility is ensuring that software quality, release quality and infrastructure quality remain high as the product evolves.



You will work closely with the lead developer and founder while maintaining an independent technical perspective.



You will help ensure that bugs, regressions, deployment mistakes, security risks and technical debt are identified before they impact customers.



This role combines:



* Quality Assurance

* Release Management

* Code Review

* Infrastructure Oversight

* Technical Documentation

* Occasional Hands-On Engineering



?



Technical Stack

Languages



* TypeScript

Frontend

* React

Backend

Data & Queueing

Integrations

Infrastructure

* GitHub Actions

* ArgoCD

* Grafana

* Loki

* Prometheus



You do not need to be an expert in every tool, but you should be senior enough to understand how these systems interact and be able to identify risks and improvement opportunities.



?



Responsibilities



Quality Assurance & Testing

This includes:



* Feature validation

* Regression testing

* Release testing

* Acceptance testing

* Bug reproduction

* Integration testing

* User flow testing

* Tracking validation

* Revenue attribution validation

* Test gate improvements

* APIs

* Tracking systems

* CRM integrations

* Revenue integrations

* Reporting systems

* Customer onboarding flows

* User permissions and access controls

* Privacy and consent-related functionality



The goal is simple:



Prevent bugs, regressions and incorrect data from reaching production.



?



Code Review & Technical Oversight



You will regularly review development work and provide technical feedback.



You should be comfortable reviewing:



Frontend



* Next.js

* React

* TypeScript

* User flows

* Responsive behaviour

* Product requirements



Backend



* Bun

* Hono

* APIs

* Authentication flows

* Database interactions

* Business logic

* Data processing workflows



Your focus is not only whether code works, but whether it is:



* Maintainable

* Scalable

* Secure

* Well structured

* Consistent with project standards



You should be able to identify:



* Technical debt

* Architectural risks

* Security risks

* Privacy-related implementation risks

* Improper handling of sensitive data

* Permission and access control issues



?



GitHub, CI/CD & Release Management



You will help maintain a professional software delivery process.



This includes:



* Branching strategies

* Pull request workflows

* Protected branches

* Merge policies

* GitHub Actions

* CI/CD pipelines

* Release validation

* Deployment workflows

* Staging reviews

* Production release reviews

* Rollback planning



You should be comfortable improving and expanding test coverage and release safeguards over time.



?



Infrastructure Oversight

However, you should be comfortable reviewing infrastructure health and identifying operational risks.



This includes:

* Deployment health

* Monitoring dashboards

* Logs and alerts

* Resource usage

* Environment configuration

* Secrets management

* Access control reviews

* Security-related deployment risks

?



Technical Contributions

Examples include:

* Small backend fixes

* CI/CD improvements

* GitHub workflow improvements

* Documentation improvements

* Monitoring improvements

* Configuration changes

* Infrastructure-related improvements



You will not be responsible for building major product features, but you should be comfortable contributing directly to the codebase when needed.



?



Documentation



You will help maintain:



* Technical documentation

* Release procedures

* Deployment documentation

* Operational playbooks

* Testing procedures

* I
 documentation



?



Requirements



Must Have

* Experience with modern TypeScript backend frameworks or runtimes

* Strong understanding of APIs and backend service design

?



Compensation

?



What Success Looks Like



* GitHub workflows are clean and protected

* Releases are predictable and well-tested

* CI/CD pipelines are reliable

* Test coverage has improved

* Technical debt is visible and controlled

* Infrastructure is stable and monitored

* Security and privacy risks are identified early

* Frontend implementations match requirements

* Bugs and regressions are caught before production

In short, your role is to ensure that poor code, broken functionality, infrastructure issues and risky releases never reach production while helping maintain a high engineering standard across the platform.

title: YouTube Content Creator – English Learning Ap
description:
YouTube Content Creator – English Learning App



We're growing an English learning app and we're looking for a talented YouTube creator to produce engaging educational videos that teach English to a wide audience. If you know how to make a video that people actually watch until the end, we want to hear from you.



What you'll be doing:



You'll be creating one YouTube video per day of 5 to 10 minutes teaching English (grammar, vocabulary, expressions, pronunciation or anything relevant) and handling everything from A to Z: scripting, filming, editing, designing the thumbnail, writing the title, description and tags to maximize reach. It doesn't have to be complicated — simple works great. You can draw inspiration from what's already performing well on YouTube and put your own spin on it. You work independently and you know what it takes to make a video perform.



What we're looking for:



C1 or C2 level English is a must. We need someone with real YouTube experience who understands the platform, knows how to create eye-catching thumbnails, and has a strong sense of what makes content engaging. Solid editing skills are required. You need to be creative, autonomous and genuinely passionate about teaching.



Compensation:



We pay $2 per hour plus a percentage of the revenue generated through YouTube monetization. The more your videos perform, the more you earn.



How to apply:



You can either send us a video you've already created and posted on YouTube, or create a new one specifically for this application. We strongly prefer the latter — it shows your commitment and gives us a much better sense of who you are as a creator. Deal? Just make a short 1 to 3 minute video teaching something in English — a conversation tip, a grammar rule, an expression, anything you feel comfortable with. Take inspiration from a video that's already working well on YouTube and put your own spin on it. The point is simple: we just want to see if you have what it takes. We'll be looking at your editing, your thumbnail, and how well you manage to keep the viewer engaged.

title: Video Editor
description:
YouTube Video Editor — Police Bodycam 

We produce long-form YouTube videos built around police bodycam, dashcam, and surveillance footage. We're looking for an editor who can turn raw, often low-quality footage into tight, retention-driven videos that hook viewers in the first 30 seconds and hold them to the end.

What you'll do

Pace edits for retention — strong cold-open hooks, clean cuts, no slow spots

Add on-screen captions/subtitles throughout (a core part of this format)

Blur faces, license plates, and redact sensitive details (names, addresses, minors) as required

Color-correct and clean up poor-quality source footage

Build supporting visuals: context cards, lower thirds, location maps, document/mugshot overlays

Layer in music and sound design that builds tension without overpowering audio

Hit consistent deadlines on a recurring upload schedule



What we're looking for



Proven long-form YouTube editing experience (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar — please specify)

A real feel for true crime / bodycam pacing and storytelling, not just technical cutting

Strong attention to detail on redaction and accuracy

Reliable communicator who can take notes and turn around revisions quickly



Nice to have



Familiarity with the bodycam/true crime genre on YouTube

Experience with caption/subtitle workflows at volume

Thumbnail or title input (bonus, not required)



To apply: Send your portfolio or 2–3 relevant long-form samples, the software you edit in, your typical turnaround time per video, and your rate (per video or hourly).

title: 2D Animator
description:
About the role:



BattlePaws is looking for a long-term, full-time 2D animator for YouTube content focused on history, mythology, battles, and immersive storytelling videos.



The channel style is inspired by:



- DumbDoggoAnimation — 

 -TheOdd1sOut — 

 -HeyHistorically — 

 -Fast-paced YouTube storytelling animation



The goal is NOT Disney-level animation quality. Strong pacing, comedic timing, visual storytelling, and retention-focused animation matter more than ultra-smooth frame-by-frame work.



Production expectations: 



 Average video length: 10–15 minutes

 Expected workload: 3 videos per month

 Future goal: 30-minute videos as the channel grows

 Minimum export quality: 1080p

 Animation software: any (After Effects, Animate, Toon Boom, Blender, etc.)



Workflow & communication



 Trello is used for project management and production tracking.

 A WhatsApp group is used for daily communication and feedback.

 English does not need to be perfect — but you must be able to clearly understand simple instructions and scripts.



What BattlePaws provides for each video: 



 Full script

 Voice-over (recorded)

 Storyboard images

All final animations and assets created for the channel belong to BattlePaws



Recruitment & filtering process: 



Step 1 — Initial Application Filter



Applicants are first filtered based on:



 Portfolio quality

 Communication

 Responsiveness

 Compatibility with the channel style

This first pass is mainly used to remove low-effort or incompatible applicants and is not heavily scored.



Required in your application (in this order):



1. Start with the word: Legion

2. Brief intro — your name, country, and years of 2D animation experience

3. Confirm you can work FULL-TIME (30–40 hrs/week, ~3 videos/month minimum)

4. Portfolio link (past animation work — at least 2–3 samples)

5. Animation software you use most

6. Your time zone (so we know if we can sync via WhatsApp)

Applications that don't include all six items above, or that don't start with "Legion," will be ignored.



Step 2 — Paid Animation Test

Selected applicants from Step 1 will be invited to a paid animation test.

The test materials are hosted in this read-only Google Drive folder:







Inside you'll find:



 The full brief (READ FIRST/)

 3 scenes of script + voice-over + storyboard images (References/, Storyboards/, Voice Over/)

 A preview MP4 showing scene-change timing

 Channel style references and mascot turntable

The storyboard is creative guidance, not strict frame-by-frame instructions. Creative improvements are welcome if they fit the channel style.



The test evaluates:



 Pacing

 Comedic timing

 Visual clarity

 Ability to follow instructions

 Communication

 Workflow organization

 Overall YouTube retention quality



Technical requirements: 



 Resolution: 1920 × 1080

 Frame rate: 30 fps

 Export format: MP4 (H.264)



Required deliverables:



 Final MP4 export

 Project files

 Assets used during production



Time & deadline: 



 Approximately 4–6 hours of work expected

 Hard deadline: 48–72 hours from receiving the test

 Smooth animation is not the priority — strong storytelling, efficient workflow, and engaging pacing matter more



How to submit:



When finished, upload your deliverables (MP4, project files, assets) to your own Google Drive folder set to view-only, then submit the link via our submission form:







The form takes ~1 minute to fill out. Do not
 files directly — the form is the only submission channel.



Step 3 — Final Selection :

The later stages of recruitment become much more selective. The final decision is based on:

 Reliability

 Communication

 Speed

 Consistency

 Ability to work long-term within the BattlePaws production pipeline



If you're officially selected after the test phase, you receive a $75 USD bonus alongside your first project's compensation.

Payment structure



 Month 1: paid per video at the starting rate

 Month 2+: increased per-video pay for strong performance

 Long-term top performers: transition into a stable full-time position with performance bonuses tied to video success



Ready to apply?



Send your application via this job post. Follow the 6-item checklist in Step 1 above — that's the only thing we check at the first pass.



We respond to all serious applications, even if it's a 'no' — silence isn't our style.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

— The BattlePaws Team

title: SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST | ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS
description:
SENIOR MARKETING & CHANNEL SPECIALIST



ABOUT ELEVATED HOSPITALITY PARTNERS



Elevated Hospitality Partners is a growing vacation rental management platform supporting multiple local hospitality brands across Texas, New Mexico, and California. We manage high-quality vacation homes with a focus on strong homeowner partnerships, thoughtful guest experiences, local market expertise, and disciplined operational execution.



As we continue to grow, we are building a centralized marketing function that supports all of our markets, improves the performance of our listings, strengthens our homeowner acquisition efforts, and helps us present a consistent, premium brand across every channel.



ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and creative Senior Marketing & Channel Specialist to support marketing across our vacation rental portfolio.



This role will report to our Chief Commercial Officer and work closely with our market teams, revenue management, onboarding, field operations, and external marketing partners.



This is a hands-on marketing role focused on listing optimization, channel content quality, website updates, homeowner acquisition marketing, referral channel support, brand consistency, and select social media support. The ideal candidate is a strong writer, comfortable with digital tools, highly organized, and excited to help build scalable marketing processes for a growing hospitality business.



This role is especially important because our listings, websites, homeowner-facing content, and referral channels directly impact our ability to grow revenue, attract new homeowners, and create a premium brand experience across every market.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



LISTING OPTIMIZATION & CHANNEL CONTENT

* Own the quality, consistency, and optimization of property listings across Guesty, Airbnb, Vrbo, Google Vacation Rentals, direct booking websites, and other distribution channels.

* Write and refine listing titles, descriptions, summaries, photo captions, amenity highlights, and market-specific content.

* Review listings for completeness, accuracy, conversion quality, and brand consistency.

* Help determine the best hero images, photo order, captions, and property highlights for each listing.

* Coordinate with market teams to confirm property details, amenities, local recommendations, and unique selling points.

* Manage the listing optimization checklist for new and existing homes.

* Support the launch of new listings by ensuring marketing content is complete, accurate, and on-brand before going live.

* Review underperforming listings and recommend content, photo, or positioning improvements.

* Manage the relationship with photography partners to help ensure property photography is high quality, consistent, and aligned with our brand standards.

* Coordinate photography needs, shot lists, photo feedback, and follow-up requests with market teams and external photographers.



WEBSITE & DIRECT BOOKING SUPPORT

* Maintain and update property pages, market pages, owner-facing pages, and other website content.

* Ensure direct booking websites are accurate, polished, and aligned with current listings and brand standards.

* Support the creation of landing pages for market-specific campaigns, homeowner acquisition, and referral partners.

* Help improve website content for SEO, readability, and conversion.

* Coordinate with website vendors or internal tea
mbers when technical changes are needed.

* Support updates to Google Business Profiles and other local search assets.



HOMEOWNER ACQUISITION MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts designed to attract new vacation rental homeowners.

* Help create and maintain homeowner-facing materials, including one-pagers, brochures, market summaries, case studies, listing improvement examples, and sales support materials.

* Support
 campaigns, nurture sequences, and other marketing efforts for prospective homeowners.

* Help package the EHP value proposition clearly across markets, including our approach to home care, revenue management, guest experience, and owner communication.

* Create market-specific content that helps homeowners understand why our local teams are the right partner for their vacation rental.



REFERRAL CHANNEL MARKETING

* Support marketing efforts for referral partners, including real estate agents, brokers, developers, designers, contractors, and other local professionals who may refer homeowners to us.

* Help create referral partner collateral, outreach materials,
 campaigns, and follow-up content.

* Maintain referral channel marketing assets and ensure they are professional, clear, and easy for partners to share.

* Support the marketing side of our lifetime value of leads strategy, helping us stay visible and valuable to referral sources over time.

* Coordinate with leadership and market teams to identify partner opportunities and create simple, repeatable campaigns.



BRAND & CONTENT CONSISTENCY

* Help maintain consistent brand voice, tone, and visual standards across all markets and channels.

* Create and manage templates for listings, owner marketing, referral partners, social media, presentations, and website content.

* Use tools like Canva and Google Workspace to produce clean, professional, on-brand marketing materials.

* Ensure each local brand feels personal and market-specific while still reflecting the quality and standards of Elevated Hospitality Partners.



REPORTING & PROCESS MANAGEMENT

* Maintain a marketing tracker for listing optimization, website updates, referral marketing, owner acquisition campaigns, and active projects.

* Provide regular updates to the Chief Commercial Officer on progress, priorities, and blockers.

title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
We are a UK-based digital marketing business working across several client websites, including a regulated financial services firm and a social enterprise. We are looking for an experienced, reliable SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist who genuinely understands SEO and Digital Marketing - primarily conversion rate optimisation (CRO), and answer engine optimisation (AEO) — not just someone who knows the buzzwords.

This is a long-term, part-time role starting with 8 – 10 hours per week -  but with the potential to grow to 20 hours per week. You will work directly with the business owner and be trusted to take ownership of your tasks.



What You Will Be Doing

SEO

• Keyword research and content gap analysis

• On-page optimisation: meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking

• Technical SEO audits: crawl errors, page speed, schema markup, canonical tags

• Writing and editing content briefs for blog posts and pillar pages

• Schema implementation guidance (JSON-LD: FAQPage, Person, Organisation, LocalBusiness)

• Google Search Console and GA4 monitoring and monthly reporting

• E-E-A-T improvements: author bios, trust signals, expertise content



CRO

• Analysing heatmaps and session recordings (Hotjar / Microsoft Clarity)

• Identifying conversion bottlenecks (and proposing A/B test hypotheses)

• Landing page copy and layout recommendations

• Reporting on key conversion metrics



AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation)

• Optimising content for featured snippets, People Also Ask, and AI Overviews

• Structuring content to support LLM citation and zero-click discovery

• FAQ and structured content creation aligned with conversational search intent

• Keeping up to date with how AI search tools (Google AI Overviews in particular, ChatGPT, Perplexity) surface content



Please outline the tools you use



What We Are Looking For

• Minimum 2 years’ experience in SEO with demonstrable results

• Ability to work independently, flag issues proactively, and meet deadlines without chasing

What We Offer

• Consistent, long-term part-time work with a UK client

• Room to grow your hours and responsibilities as trust builds

• Prompt payment



How to Apply
